name: GitHub Pusher
description: Pushes files and small commits to a GitHub repository using a workspace-scoped Personal Access Token. Built for environments where direct git access is blocked but the GitHub REST API is reachable: every push is replayed server-side via the Git Database API (blobs, trees, commits, refs), so the host never has to speak github.com on the wire.

github_token.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
github_token.description: Needs `repo` scope. Stays on the plugin author's server; never reaches the iframe.

hooks.name: Push files to GitHub
hooks.description: Commits one or more files to the configured repository via the Git Database API. Each call lands as one commit on the chosen branch; the API is used end-to-end so this works even when `github.com` itself is unreachable from the caller's network.

branch.description: Target branch. Created from the default base branch when missing.

message.description: Commit message. First line is the summary; the rest is body.

files.description: Map of repo-relative path to UTF-8 file content. Paths must be POSIX-style and may not start with '/' or contain '..'.

update_only.description: When true, refuse to add or remove files; only patch existing ones.

hooks.name: Create branch from base
hooks.description: Creates `new_branch` from `base_branch` when it does not exist. Refuses silently if the branch is already present; the push hook reuses this branch transparently.

base_branch.description: Defaults to the configured default branch.
